title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
author: Marc Peter Deisenroth, A. Aldo Faisal & Cheng Soon Ong
abstract: Bridges the mathematical gap for machine learning, covering linear algebra, analytic geometry, matrix decompositions, vector calculus, probability, optimization, and four foundational ML algorithms.

title: Think Python: How to Think Like a Computer Scientist (2nd Ed.)
author: Allen B. Downey
abstract: A hands-on introduction to software design and computational thinking in Python 3, progressing from variables, functions, and recursion to data structures, object-oriented programming, and debugging.

title: Think Stats: Exploratory Data Analysis in Python (2nd Ed.)
author: Allen B. Downey
abstract: An applied introduction to probability and statistics for programmers, emphasizing computational simulation, empirical distributions, hypothesis testing, estimation, regression, and survival analysis on real datasets.

title: Open Data Structures (in Python)
author: Pat Morin
abstract: A rigorous open-access computer science textbook covering array-based lists, linked lists, skip lists, hash tables, binary search trees, red-black trees, heaps, sorting, and graph representations with Python implementations.

title: Foundations of Data Science
author: Avrim Blum, John Hopcroft & Ravindran Kannan
abstract: Developed by Turing Award winner John Hopcroft with Avrim Blum and Ravindran Kannan, this text presents the modern theoretical foundations of data science: high-dimensional geometry, SVD, random walks, streaming algorithms, clustering, and topic modeling.

title: Think Bayes: Bayesian Statistics in Python
author: Allen B. Downey
abstract: A computational approach to Bayesian statistics using Python, teaching prior/posterior updating, conjugate distributions, hierarchical models, decision analysis, and MCMC through real-world problems.

title: Pro Git (2nd Edition)
author: Scott Chacon & Ben Straub
abstract: The comprehensive open-source guide to Git version control, covering repository fundamentals, branching and rebasing workflows, distributed collaboration, GitHub workflows, debugging with bisect, hooks, and Git internals.

title: Think DSP: Digital Signal Processing in Python
author: Allen B. Downey
abstract: A practical engineering introduction to digital signal processing in Python, covering periodic signals, spectral decomposition, spectrograms, noise, autocorrelation, discrete cosine transforms, and digital filters.
